name: sancera
description: Official statistics and public registers for Sweden, the Nordics and the EU, with source link and Excel/CSV in every answer.

interface.longDescription: Sancera gives ChatGPT direct access to official statistics and public registers for Sweden, the Nordics and the EU: Statistics Sweden (population, GDP and the full table catalogue), Eurostat, Riksbanken and ECB rates and exchange rates, IMF forecasts, Nordic electricity prices, Swedish municipal statistics (Kolada), company registers and annual reports, insider and short-position registers, trade, job vacancies, EU tenders and Swedish legislation and case law. Ask in plain language. Each answer returns the official figure with period, unit, the source, a link to the source and an Excel/CSV download. Sancera never creates or alters figures, and it is not a people database. Questions work in English, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish and Finnish.
defaultPrompt: How many people live in Malmö, and how has it changed over the last ten years?
Compare electricity prices in SE3 and SE4 for the past week.
Show Sweden's year-on-year GDP growth for the last eight quarters, with an Excel file.
